name: Patrick Farrelly
bio: a Representative from Pennsylvania; born in Ireland in 1770, where he completed his education; immigrated to the United States in 1798; studied law; was admitted to the bar July 11, 1803, and commenced practice in Meadville, Pa.; member of the Pennsylvanian state house of representatives in 1811 and 1812; served in the War of 1812 as a major of militia; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Seventeenth Congress, reelected as a Jackson Republican to the Eighteenth Congress and as a Jacksonian candidate to the Nineteenth Congress and served from March 4, 1821, until his death in Meadville, Crawford County, Pa., January 12, 1826; interment in Greendale Cemetery.
